title: Page 214
transc:
Baldwin Balto  Wash June 14" 63
For agate It is reported that
Whiffs and Whiskeys corps have passed
through India to Madrid towards the
Valley signed Abel Clara how so


11 am  Wash June 14 63
For Adorn For the prompt removal
of our sick and the military
stores at Hastings to Alexandria consequent
upon the Walnut Zodiac now in
progress the Vincent Dept requires temporarily
every available spoon period You will
please forward immy to Harm every
Spit not indispensable to your safety
period The case is urgent but
merely temporary and they will be
sent back to you Arabia Francis
